thread:
leigh-cs: FYI BlueHarbor renewal in final step but finance flagged mismatch: PO is for BlueHarbor UK Ltd (billing), payment coming from BlueHarbor US (card). Customer asked if we can bill the UK entity and accept a US card/payment. Need legal + ops input asap, they want this closed before EOD.

omar-am: Quick clarifier 1212 are we keeping the current 12mo commitment? customer mentioned potential swap to monthly for first 3 months then annual. That would affect invoicing schedule.

leigh-cs: They agreed to stay on 12mo but requested invoice split: initial 1mo pro-rate followed by annual invoice. Also asked for a 5% one-time ``onboarding credit'' if we accept mixed-entity billing. PO: BH-2026-9001.

tara-legal: @leigh-cs we need the PO text & signatory name. Mixed-entity billing + card charged from a different legal entity needs a short addendum and tax confirmation. Some UK customers require wet signature for entity acceptance. Please provide signer's title.

nina-ops: Finance note: we generally won't accept a US card to pay an invoice addressed to a UK entity unless there's a vendor code + W-8/UK VAT confirmation. Alternative: issue invoice to UK entity and have US entity do an intercompany recharge. Which does the customer prefer?

leigh-cs: PO snippet attached: ```PO BH-2026-9001
Bill To: BlueHarbor UK Ltd
Payment: BlueHarbor US Corp (credit card)
Vendor Code: BH-VC-44``` Signer: "Marta L., Head of Procurement".

omar-am: If customer wants the 5% credit, need AM approval. I'll flag for pricing signoff but prefer to get legal/ops aligned first.

tara-legal: Draft addendum suggestion: "Billing Allocation: Customer confirms BlueHarbor UK Ltd is the billed entity. BlueHarbor US Corp authorizes payment on behalf of the billed entity and accepts responsibility for payment; Customer will ensure appropriate VAT/tax handling and provide either VAT registration or indemnity for Redwood Inference against tax liabilities." If UK wet-sign required, we can include a clause allowing DocuSign with a notarized sign if requested.

nina-ops: Ops can accept wire to UK bank or card from US corp if customer provides either: (a) vendor code + UK VAT reg certificate, or (b) a signed remit authorization + indemnity. If they want CC fallback, we need an explicit backup authorization window in the addendum. Also note FX: invoice will be in GBP unless they request USD conversion and accept FX fees.

leigh-cs: I asked customer which route: they said wire to UK preferred, card only if wire delayed. They also asked if we can put "payor" field separate on invoice (payor = BlueHarbor US Corp).

omar-am: I'll document the 5% onboarding credit request (conditional on accepting mixed-entity payment) and push for final approval. If legal requires indemnity, that likely negates the credit.

tara-legal: Please have them sign the addendum. Sample indemnity clause we will use: ```Customer Indemnity: Customer agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Redwood Inference against any tax, penalty, or interest arising from invoices issued to BlueHarbor UK Ltd and paid by a third-party payer, except where Redwood has acted negligently.```

ds-bot: DocuSign envelope created: https://docusign.com/envelope/BH-EN-7788 12 status: sent (2 pending).

nina-ops: I'll prepare two invoice templates: (1) UK invoice (GBP) with vendor code and wire instructions, (2) UK invoice with separate payor field and CC fallback note. ETA 30m.

leigh-cs: Customer replied: will try wire this week, but asked for invoice today to attach to internal PO process. They also agreed to sign the addendum via DocuSign if acceptable.

omar-am: Cool. I'll hold off the 5% credit ask until legal confirms. If we approve the credit, we'll make it a one-time line item credit on the first invoice.

tara-legal: Good plan. @nina-ops please withhold final invoice send until addendum signed OR we have a signed remit authorization + VAT proof. If they sign but do not provide VAT proof, we proceed with indemnity clause included.

nina-ops: Understood 12 holding send.

leigh-cs: Thx team. I'll post when envelope is signed or if customer confirms wire today. :thumbsup:
